critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 481 lines (right at limit); consider extracting IntlShipmentDetail into its own file for maintainability.
is-drawer (Factories) and is-modal (New shipment) still lack Escape-to-close handler; only Detail listens for Escape. Adding a shared overlay Escape handler would match the tooltip 'Back (Esc)' UX.

The 'Needing payment' overview tile (is-kpi-released) maps to status='prepayment' (Awaiting-prepayment stage) while the pipeline pill labelled 'Prepaid' (is-stage-prepaid) is a different downstream stage. The two look semantically similar and could confuse users — consider aligning the copy or grouping their tooltips.

Orders tab has 4 simplified is-oo-kpi-* tiles (figure+caption only) + is-open-orders board with is-oo-customer MultiSelect. 0 console errors, 0 overflow across 1920/1280/390 widths.
